2116529872269185354.en_summary: Luke Gromen praises a quoted analysis on the fallacy of China being Japan regarding consumption and debt trap, noting fundamental differences as China is not doing vendor financing, with positive long-term consequences for Chinese consumption and opposite for US with inflation and weakening currency.
2116529872269185354.zh_summary: Luke Gromen 稱讚所引關於中國不是日本的謬誤分析，涉及消費和債務陷阱，指出根本差異因中國不進行供應商融資，對中國消費有積極長期後果，而對美國則相反，伴隨通脹和貨幣走弱。

2116529278238248981.en_summary: Schuldensuehner notes there’s life beyond AI: the S&P 500 ex-AI just hit a new all-time high, up 14.2% YTD vs 11.8% for the headline index, with equal weight +15.3%, all including dividends. The AI trade isn’t the whole stock market.
2116529278238248981.zh_summary: Schuldensuehner 指出人工智能之外還有生活：標普 500 剔除人工智能成分剛創歷史新高，年初至今上漲 14.2%，而頭條指數為 11.8%，等權重 +15.3%，均含股息。人工智能交易並非整個股票市場。

ticker_notes.SPY: 剔除 AI 後年初至今 +14.2%，優於整體

2116529180318081339.en_summary: Scott Melker discusses if going public is really about stock price going up, quoting Dan Held that IPOs give liquidity and hedging ways, disappointing Kraken hasn't IPO'd yet, noting Coinbase is down 50% from IPO and public markets mean active trading and liquidity not just number go up.
2116529180318081339.zh_summary: Scott Melker 討論上市是否真的關於股價上漲，引用 Dan Held 說 IPO 提供流動性和對沖方式，對 Kraken 尚未上市感到失望，指出 Coinbase 自 IPO 以來下跌 50%，公開市場意味著活躍交易和流動性而非僅數字上漲。
